program_lessons.lesson: Thin margins make micro-optimism fatal; report margin-to-fail

program_lessons.lesson: A control's verdict is conditional on its data authority
program_lessons.binding: every V4 control must RUN under evidenced semantics; controls recomputed whenever data semantics change

program_lessons.lesson: Exact reproduction reproduces the bug, too
program_lessons.binding: REPRODUCTION_ALL_MATCH read as self-consistency only; positive results require the four-layer test

program_lessons.lesson: Freeze the rules while calm; they are the only thing that holds when it hurts
